Author: Sunita Agarwal
Bench: Sunita Agarwal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 39
Case :- Writ - C No. - 38919 of 2022
Petitioner :- Ajay Kumar Jain And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ramesh Kumar,Devaang Savla

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Mahesh Narain Singh,Ravi Prakash Pandey Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Nand Prabha Shukla,J.

The petitioners herein seek a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents not to disposses him from Khasra No.494M ad-measuring 0.0030 hectares located at Village Makanpur, Pargana Loni,
Tehsil and District Ghaziabad.

The specific contention in the writ petition is that two plots namely, Khasra No.694 and 695 belonging to the petitioners had been acquired by acquisition notifications dated 12.09.1986 and 24.02.1988 under Sections 4 and 6 of the Land Acquisition Act.
However, Khasra No.494M was not included in the acquisition proceedings.
The compensation with regard to the acquired land had been paid to the petitioners.

Copy of the Form-11 has been appended as annexure '3' to the writ petition to assert that the compensation was awarded to the petitioners in respect to Khasra No.694 Ajay Kumar Jain And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 9 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111919408/
1 and 695 only.

entities.text: Khasra No.694 Ajay Kumar Jain And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further stated that the petitioners are still in possession over the plot bearing Khasra No.494M and their names continued to be duly recorded in the revenue records.

It is then stated that the respondent development authority is illegally trying to disposses the petitioners as is trying to make development by raising constructions over plot No.494M which is adjacent and conjoint to Khasra No.694 and 695 and as the said plot has been included in the construction plan,
illegally.

As against this submission, Sri Mahesh Narain Singh, learned Advocate appearing for the Development Authority has provided a copy of the notification dated 22.02.1989 under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act to assert that plot No.494, area 1-0-0 of the village in question namely, the plot in question, subject matter of dispute in the present petition, has been acquired for the project of Ghaziabad Development Authority.
The Section 6 notification has been issued on 22.02.1989, award has been declared and compensation has been paid to the recorded tenure holder Dharamveer, who is not party to the writ petition.
It appears that the petitioners herein are subsequent purchasers of the acquired plot.
Be that as it may, it appears that the present writ petition has been filed by concealment of material facts.

On the request made by Sri Devaang Savla, learned counsel for the petitioners the matters adjourned for the day to enable him to seek instructions from the petitioners with regard to the acquisition of plot no.494 by acquisition notification dated 22.02.1989 and the contention of learned counsel for the respondents that the recorded tenure holder of the said plot was Dharamveer.
It is also made clear that the petitioners shall also be required to answer as to why cost be not imposed upon them for concealment of the material facts, in an effort to misuse the process of law.
As prayed, put up this matter as fresh on 20.02.2023.

Order Date :- 9.2.2023 Mini  Ajay Kumar Jain And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 9 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111919408/
